title: Sony FX9 6K Full-Frame Cinema & Broadcast Camera (PXW-FX9)
purpose: Ergonomic shoulder-mount and broadcast documentary full-frame cinema camera built around a 6K oversampled Exmor R CMOS sensor, Dual Base ISO 800/4000, Electronic Variable ND filter, and 15+ stops of tonal latitude.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 35.7 x 18.8mm Full-Frame 6K Oversampled Exmor R CMOS sensor (6008x3168 readout downsampled to ultra-crisp 4K 10-bit 4:2:2)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 35mm full-frame cinema field of view (shoulder-balanced E-mount ENG/cine rig)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Sony FE PZ 28-135mm F4 G OSS (SELP28135G) / FE 50mm F1.2 GM cine sweet spot
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: Dual Base ISO 800 / 4000 (S-Log3 / S-Cinetone) with Electronic Variable ND (1/4 to 1/128)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15+ stops dynamic range with 6K-to-4K full-pixel oversampling eliminating moire and aliasing
sensor_and_optics.shutter: 180-degree cinema shutter angle (1/48s motion cadence) with Genlock broadcast synchronization

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Controlled documentary key with natural architectural bounce and electronic ND daylight balance calibrated to Dual Base ISO 800/4000
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Fine 6K oversampled tonal transitions preserving delicate facial contours, crisp hair texture, and smooth highlight roll-off

surface_rendering: High-acutance 6K oversampled readout resolving fine weave and clean specular edges without moire or stair-stepping
Smooth S-Cinetone broadcast-cinema skin reproduction tuned directly to Sony cinema colorimetry
Zero electronic edge ringing or harsh digital contrast curves
depth_and_optics: Full-frame 6K cinema separation with stable shoulder-mounted documentary composition
Electronic Variable ND maintaining constant T/f-stop depth across changing outdoor exposure
Fast Hybrid AF tracking subjects smoothly without focus hunting

execution_directive: Enforce Sony FX9 (PXW-FX9) 6K oversampled full-frame Exmor R cinema capture with Dual Base ISO 800/4000, Electronic Variable ND control, zero moire texture fidelity, and 15+ stops S-Cinetone tonal graduation.
